title: Carbon and cost report
description: Estimate the energy, carbon and cost of an analysis before you run it, and keep the estimate with your project records.
intro: Before running an analysis on a collection, you can estimate how much electricity it will use, how much CO2 that means, and what it will cost. This page turns the estimate into a report you can attach to a project plan or file with the project records.
Nothing on this page runs a job, connects a wallet or spends money. It is arithmetic on published figures, and every figure says where it comes from.

form.heading: 1. Describe the analysis
form.purposeHint: What will be analysed, and why. This goes into the report as written.
form.linesHint: One line per option. To compare places, keep the jobs and minutes the same.
form.mode: These options are alternatives — only one will run
form.modeHint: Leave this on to compare places. Turn it off if every line will actually run; the report then adds them up.

defaults.reportTitle: Text recognition for a digitised collection
defaults.purpose: Example: text recognition (OCR) for about 12,000 page images, split into 40 jobs of about 30 minutes each. The figures are assumptions for planning, not measurements of an OCR run.

report.heading: 3. The report
report.status: Planning estimate — not a record of jobs that were run
report.lowerBound: Options that cannot be estimated are left out of the totals, not counted as zero. Treat the totals as a lower bound.
report.totalsAreSum: Totals add up every line, because every line will run.
report.empty: Add at least one option to see the report.
report.ratio: The highest is about {x} times the lowest, for the same work.
report.compareCounted: Compared {n} of {total} options. Options that cannot be estimated are not ranked.

legend.heading: What the labels mean
legend.measured: Power was measured by us on the actual machine.
legend.provider-reported: Stated by the provider. There is no way for us to check it.
legend.portal-estimated: Calculated by this portal from hardware specifications. Not measured.
legend.unknown: Not enough is known to give a number, so none is given.

reasons.no-location: This environment does not say where it physically runs, so emissions cannot be calculated.
reasons.no-grid: No checked figure for the carbon intensity of this region's electricity is registered yet.
reasons.no-power: The power draw of this environment has not been measured yet.

assumptions.heading: Assumptions and limits
items: Every option is assumed to take the same time. Faster hardware may finish sooner, which would lower its figures.
Only the electricity used while the job runs is counted. The carbon of building the hardware is not.
CPU power is not included: it cannot be measured from inside a virtual machine.
Emissions use the average carbon intensity of the local grid (location-based). Green-energy certificates are not subtracted.
Sources use different methods: some count the full life cycle of the power station, others only what is emitted when power is generated. Compare regions with that in mind.

export.heading: Keep a copy
export.fixityHint: If the JSON file you keep gives the same value, it is the same file this report describes.
